text: Ekopak NV is listed on Euronext Brussels; its 22 May 2025 transparency notification shows Marc Coucke controlling 57.64% of the voting rights through Alychlo NV and Mylecke Management, Art & Invest NV.
short: Ekopak (Euronext): Marc Coucke controls 57.64% via Alychlo NV.

source.name: Ekopak NV: Transparantiekennisgevingen 22 mei 2025 (Pilovan – Alychlo) (regulated information, PDF)
source.quote: Marc Coucke controleert Alychlo NV en Mylecke Management, Art & Invest NV
source.note: The notification's table shows a total of 10,089,536 voting rights = 57.64% after the transaction of 16/05/2025; Ekopak's share page lists Euronext Brussels, ISIN BE0974380124. The same notification shows Pilovan BV (Pieter Loose) dropping below the 25% threshold on 16/05/2025.
